title: Long-Term Functional and Anatomical Outcome after Descemet Stripping Automated Endothelial Keratoplasty: A Prospective Single-Center Study
indication: Fuchs endothelial dystrophy in 108/114 eyes, pseudophakic bullous keratopathy 4, decompensation/primary graft failure 2 (Table 1); all 114 eyes pseudophakic

groups.description: DSAEK cohort, 114 eyes of 95 patients, Rotterdam Eye Hospital 2007-2011, three surgeons; Euro Cornea Bank donors (8.5 mm) prepared by the surgeon with a Moria microkeratome; insertion with a 10-0 prolene pull-through suture or the Busin glide; standard dexamethasone regimen

series.baseline_label: Baseline = donor ECD from the eye bank (Methods 2.4: provided by the Euro Cornea Bank, trypan-blue stained tissue, light microscopy, manual count)
series.notes: Table 2 row 'Graft ECD (cells/mm2)', columns Baseline, 1, 3, 6 months, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 years; mean ± SD with per-visit n in the cell text. Postoperative ECD by confocal (Confoscan 4) or specular (Topcon SP-1P) microscopy with manual counting.

exclusions.what: Last-follow-up (LFU) ECD in the Results text
exclusions.reason: Undated final-visit value (not a fixed follow-up time) and not in a table

exclusions.what: Table 2 rows BSCVA, straylight and corneal thickness

notes: Role: standard DSAEK without an investigational agent; single control-role group.
Four grafts failed late (59, 60, 73 and 84 months); whether failed grafts contribute to the 5- and 7-year means is not stated.
Data for 56 patients came from the Netherlands Organ Transplant Registry and for 39 from a prospective study; 114 eyes included, 108 with a baseline donor ECD (Table 2).
